verdict.rationale: Supabase Cron is a first-party Postgres module for scheduling recurring jobs with cron syntax. Jobs can be created via SQL or the Dashboard, run anywhere from every second to once a year, and can execute SQL/database functions or make HTTP requests such as invoking Edge Functions; run monitoring is included. Queues add durable background-task handling. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented multi-step workflow orchestration beyond cron-triggered functions, and explicit docs on agents creating schedules (only implied through SQL execution via MCP).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Supabase Cron is a Postgres Module that simplifies scheduling recurring Jobs with cron syntax and monitoring Job runs inside Postgres.
Cron Jobs can be created via SQL or the Integrations -> Cron interface inside the Dashboard, and can run anywhere from every second to once a year
Every Job can run SQL snippets or database functions with zero network latency or make an HTTP request, such as invoking a Supabase Edge Function.
